summary: Added the missing joint-history reasoning that the controller required when citing a receipt from a separate producer experiment. The update keeps the configuration-recovery account for 98ee8dfd5fac4b84915f91ed4b094bcf-question-0 as it stands (violated, defect asserted, same sources, same successful-revision receipts, same counterevidence) and adds receipt 4ed46b198c8d41618cc855df0a63d469 from experiment 6b30dd76d4b64190be2808a0e7abb041 with explicit compatibility grounds: that experiment is an earlier revision of the same three-voter commit-rule probe, starting the identical group with the same configured ids and driver (its event 0 records leader C and all three servers), and it contributes no independent observation because it aborted in construction at setup ('snapshot on A failed: nothing new to snapshot') before any result event, so it is cited only for its start event and recorded as a provenance limitation, alongside a second limitation noting that the manual snapshot it attempted needs committed entries past the trailing-log bound, which the successful revision establishes explicitly before restarting the node.
